title: GET /items/:id returns one item or 404
intent: Clients need to fetch a single item by id. Return the item as JSON with 200 when it exists, and { "error": "not found" } with 404 when it does not. A non-integer id is also a 404.

title: POST /items enforces a name length limit
intent: Names longer than 64 characters are rejected with 400 and { "error": "name too long" }. Names of exactly 64 characters are accepted. The existing missing-name 400 behavior is unchanged.

title: GET /health reports uptime seconds
intent: Operators want to know how long the process has been up. GET /health returns { "status": "ok", "uptime_seconds": <integer >= 0> } computed from process start. The status field is unchanged.

title: DELETE /items/:id requires an admin bearer token
intent: Operators need to remove items. DELETE /items/:id deletes the item and returns 204. The route is protected: the request must carry Authorization: Bearer <token> where <token> equals process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN; a missing or wrong token returns 401 { "error": "unauthorized" } and deletes nothing. When ADMIN_TOKEN is unset the route always returns 401. An unknown or non-integer id with a valid token returns 404 { "error": "not found" }. No other route changes.

title: GET /items supports ?limit=N
intent: Clients paging a large list need a cap. GET /items?limit=N returns at most N items in insertion order. N must be a positive integer; a missing limit returns everything (unchanged); a non-integer, zero, or negative limit returns 400 { "error": "invalid limit" }.

title: GET /items supports ?q= substring filter
intent: Clients need to search by name. GET /items?q=text returns only items whose name contains text, case-insensitive. An empty q returns everything. Combines with limit if both are present: filter first, then cap.

title: GET /health reports the package version
intent: Operators want to see what is deployed. GET /health adds "version": the version string from toy/package.json, read once at startup. Existing status and uptime_seconds fields are unchanged.

title: Unknown routes return JSON 404
intent: Clients currently get an HTML 404 from Express for unmatched paths. Any request to a path that matches no route returns 404 with JSON body { "error": "not found" }. Existing routes are unchanged.

title: Request log line per request
intent: Operators want a request log. Every request writes one line to stdout after the response is sent: method, path, status code, and elapsed milliseconds, space-separated. Disabled when NODE_ENV is "test" so the suite output stays clean.

title: GET /items supports ?sort=name|id
intent: Clients need ordered lists. GET /items?sort=name sorts by name ascending (locale-insensitive, plain string compare); ?sort=id is the default insertion order. Any other sort value returns 400 { "error": "invalid sort" }. Combines with q and limit: filter, sort, then cap.

title: Item gains a created_at timestamp
intent: Every Item now carries "created_at": an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp set when the item is created. It is returned by POST /items, GET /items, and GET /items/:id. This changes the stored Item shape; existing tests that deep-equal an Item must be updated to account for the new field.

title: Item gains optional tags
intent: Items can be labelled. POST /items accepts an optional "tags": string[] (each tag 1–32 chars, at most 10 tags; anything else is 400 { "error": "invalid tags" }). Items store and return "tags" (default []). This changes the stored Item shape and the POST validation; GET responses include tags.
